nalli:10502150684971.description: Miraaya is handwoven in pure silk with gold and silver zari, showcasing the finesse of Kadhua craftsmanship across its body, flowing borders, and richly woven brocade pallu. Twisting vines, created in the Alfi technique using two shuttles, move through the border in alternating gold and silver zari, while layered leaves evoke a quiet sense of continuity. Floral butas echo these organic forms across the body, and the brocade pallu completes the weave with depth and balance.

nalli:10341942165803.description: Mahira organza saree is inspired by the hydrangea blooms of the Art Nouveau movement. Along the border and edges, bold, simplified hydrangea blooms pair with fluid, curving stems. The flowers gain soft dimension through pani-zari zardozi, while antique-gold aari embroidery adds depth and balance. The pallu features three large asymmetrical butas, formed as flowing clusters of hydrangea blooms and stems, creating a graceful focal point.

nalli:10062403174699.description: The Bimla from our Breezy Bengal Cotton Collection blends Bengal folklore with Jamdani artistry. Its body features diagonal foliage patterns, complemented by zari-striped borders and a shimmering zari pallu. Crafted from breathable cotton, it beautifully balances tradition with contemporary elegance.

nalli:10053263622443.description: Embrace luck and timeless beauty with "Luck 'n Love", a Tussar silk saree inspired by clover motifs symbolizing hope, faith, and love. With intricately woven bands, a plain zari border, and a striped pallu, it drapes gracefully, exuding charm, positivity, and prosperity.

nalli:10053252481323.description: Step into a world of tussars with Pomegranate Poetry by Nalli, celebrating joy and abundance. This Tussar silk saree features a plain first half, while the other half showcases pomegranate butis. A zari border and lined pallu enhance its soft, lustrous drape with timeless grace.

nalli:10421173911851.description:
Thiruvakshi is inspired by Dravidian architecture with iconic gopurams, mandapas & kodimarams. The pallu features Prabhavali (circle of flames) with powerful Yaali flanked by Gajja Yalis. Kodimarams alternate as temple flagposts symbolising Lord Brahma with Brahma Kamal. Ghetti border with minnal pet frames and kamalam buttas in the body.
Technique: Handwoven

nalli:10421173879083.description: Inspired by heavenly gardens, the Gauhar - Banarasi Saree features an opulent floral jhaal across the body. Its border showcases intricate floral motifs framed by zari twill stripes. The pallu blends a floral garden with a golden pata, while solid zari twill mirrors the border?s elegance.

nalli:10062939193643.description: The Vanasingaaram Kanchipuram silk saree, woven in 165 handloom hours, features Vanasingaram patterns on the body, a floral twill border, and a pallu adorned with golden floral and reku motifs. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it drapes beautifully, making it perfect for auspicious occasions.

nalli:10062083752235.description: The Mayilkan Kanchipuram silk saree, woven in 170 handloom hours, features lover peacock motifs on the body, a twill border, and a petni pallu with peacock designs. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it offers a fine drape, perfect for auspicious occasions.

nalli:10061121618219.description: The Aaditi Kanchipuram silk saree, crafted in 165 handloom hours, features floral and deer motifs on the body. The thalampu creeper border adds elegance, while the pallu is adorned with traditional floral brooch designs. A timeless weave, perfect for celebrating heritage and tradition.

nalli:10057492169003.description: The Malligai Kanchipuram silk saree takes 275 handloom weaving hours, featuring a korvai border and petni pallu. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it showcases malligai butta motifs on the body, mayilkan and geometric florals on the border, and stylized malligai floral designs on the pallu.

nalli:10057490989355.description: The Mrignayani Kanchipuram silk saree is handwoven over 165 hours in four-ply pure silk for a fine drape. Deer motifs adorn the body, floral thalampu creepers grace the border, and the pallu features intricate talaisaman designs, reflecting timeless craftsmanship and elegance.

nalli:10061240009003.description: Experience harmony in the Bhumi Light Blue Banarasi Saree, adorned with floral zari buta in a half-drop pattern. The zari border, featuring floral arrangements, mirrors the sober pallu with seamless floral vines. Intricate embellishments and a delicate flower bouquet motif enhance the elegance, creating a beautifully balanced drape.

nalli:10059475222827.description: Inspired by heavenly gardens, the Gauhar - Banarasi Saree features an opulent floral jhaal across the body. Its border showcases intricate floral motifs framed by zari twill stripes. The pallu blends a floral garden with a golden pata, while solid zari twill mirrors the border’s elegance.

nalli:10090937778475.description: Rekha is a traditional vairioosi saree with finely woven dashed stripes. Commanding borders feature majestic Gandaberunda motifs in ornate chariots surrounded by foliage, flowers, and mayils. Yali motifs flank central bands with miniature temple borders. Pallu showcases powerful Gaja Yalis and mayilkann.

nalli:10090938007851.description: Esha features classic kuyilkann ghetti borders paired with bold beet butas at the bottom and delicate kamalam butis across the body. The highlight is the grand double-colour pallu, richly woven with intricate ghetti work and resham pet, making it a statement piece of timeless craftsmanship.

nalli:10068025442603.description:
Tamira celebrates Tamil bridal tradition, inspired by sacred Kaasu Mahalai—gold coins blessed by Goddess Saraswati. Lotus motifs in borders honour the goddess with authentic temple jewellery details. Features a mustard silk twill weave between double zari borders. Harmonious kamalam motifs complement rare handwoven seepu reku pallu.
Crafted In: Pure Silk | Pure Gold Zari
Technique: Handwoven

nalli:10071729144107.description:
Kamala draws from rare archival two-pallu Kanjeevaram designs. One pallu features sacred kamalam motifs, rudraksha pet borders & rich zari bands. The other showcases handwoven thazhampoo reku with delicate butis. Golden kamalam butis appear melted into the silk body with precision. 
Crafted In: Pure Silk, Pure Gold Zari
Technique: Handwoven | Korwai | Petni

nalli:10068027310379.description:
Tamira celebrates Tamil bridal tradition, inspired by sacred Kaasu Mahalai—gold coins blessed by Goddess Saraswati. Lotus motifs in borders honour the goddess with authentic temple jewellery details. nalli:10347763990827.description: Amodhini is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold and silver zari. Silver Vanki Pet lines frame a compact Kamalam Pet, enriched with two-tone Meenakari over gold zari. Small Mayil butas bring measured rhythm across the body, while the pallu echoes the border with individually woven peacock motifs. Refined in detail, graceful in presence.

nalli:10347763826987.description: Malar is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, inspired by the symmetry of temple architecture. The Korwai temple border features a traditional double pet with Kamalam motifs accented in meenakari and silk thread work, finished with Manga Moggu. Monochrome Kasa-Kasa Kattam checks with Kamalam butas and a Yanai floral pallu complete its composed grandeur.

nalli:10347763302699.description: Aathira is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold zari, shaped by the grace of the cypress motif. A fine border with leaf detailing and Lavangipoo Peth glows softly in gold, while delicate floral butas rest across the silk body. The contrasting pallu features rhythmic cypress patterns enriched with Mayil and Yanai motifs, creating a poised and distinguished drape.

nalli:10333400793387.description: Woven with precision, this saree captures Kanjeevaram elegance. Kottadi kattam checks hold floral motifs, shimmering with silk. Borders unite dhavana kodi, kamalam kattu, and mayil kann. The pallu features veldhari accents. A drape rooted in heritage, it carries the warmth of tradition beautifully.

nalli:10322676482347.description: Rudraksha features innovative half-and-half design with mirrored sections separated by the symmetric division of warp colors. Borders showcase twill-weave ghetti, cross-kamalam pet, and manga motifs. The iconic 16-inch pallu buta reimagines traditional rudraksh with jadai nagam, cross kamala, pavun pet motifs.

nalli:10322675302699.description:
